Name: Ilucie's Hermit Crabs (for 1.6)
Author: IlucieYt
Description:
Adorable hermit crabs for your coop that love to swim in your ponds!
The base was my rock crab mod: I removed the rocks, altered the base-crabs, put shells on them and here they are: colorful little hermit crabs! 

They come in three different colors: red, green and pink
Standard drop is a clam, deluxe drop a rainbow shell. 

Funfact: they make bird sounds, because some hermit crab can "chirp". They do it when they are under stress or while fighting for a shell.

I made this mod because I have hermit crabs in real life and I just love them <3

Downloads.Description: hermit crabs can now swim in ponds
